title: Vickers Wellington N2749
memorial_details:
description: THIS PLAQUE OVERLOOKS THE SITE / WHERE WELLINGTON IC N2749, OF 27 OTU / RAF LICHFIELD, CRASHED IN THE EARLY / HOURS OF 19TH JULY 1942. THERE WERE / NO SURVIVORS. / CREW LIST (Names)
MEMORIAL DONATED BY / THE ROYAL BRITISH LEGION / MILFORD HAVEN BRANCH / ERECTED BY PRESELI DISTRICT COUNCIL / FOR THE PEMBROKESHIRE AVIATION GROUP / JULY 1988 / LEST WE FORGET
